column1: The Lantern Leviathan — an anglerfish the size of the reactor. Arena: the Lowest Vault until tide 12; after that its lure appears anywhere in the galleries, warrens, and station (it swims the tubes), so the whole descent is the arena.

HP 15,000 (x1.08 per tide); armor: its body is dark and hard to see (hits on the body do 50%); weak point: the gills behind the lure, exposed for 2 s after every Swallow and for 5 s when the lure is shot out (500 damage to the lure).

Phase 1 (100-60%): Lure (an emergency light appears where none was; curious beasts and divers drift to it), Swallow (a diver taken whole: teammates have 5 s to deal 200 to the gills), Bite. It stays in the black coral.

Phase 2 (60-30%): Dark (every light in 30 m goes out for 6 s: lamps, kelp, beacons; only its lure remains), and it moves through the vault's coral like a shark through kelp; sixgills follow the blood it makes.

Phase 3 (30-0%): the lure splits into three (two are decoys that Swallow nothing but hold a diver 2 s); it drops the collapsing ledge if a diver stands on Overlook 5; the Relict may arrive for the corpses and fight it (the Relict wins one time in three).

Arena rules: shooting out the lure blinds it 5 s; the reactor vent scalds it for 10% if it's lured into the Reactor hall (Beacon 4); black coral can be shot down to open sightlines (loud); Widow's Ink and Cold Coffin are sold in its own vault for a reason.

Kill reward: 1,500 base scrip x tide, a Locker weapon each, and the station's master key (opens tank 7: the Relict egg, which starts the Abyssal Lure quest). It reforms in the vault after 6 minutes at 50% HP.
